thesis: Constellation is the nuclear-AI power thesis in timeout: the stock has fallen ~41% from its $412.70 high to $244 as the 'AI premium' deflated - PJM interconnection rules for data centers are unresolved until late 2026, the Crane restart (Microsoft PPA, $1.6B investment) faces potential delay to 2031, and DOJ-required divestitures punched a hole in 2026-27 earnings. Meanwhile the operating business is fine: Q1 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.74 beat consensus, revenue doubled to $11.1B on Calpine, and FY26 guidance of $11.00-12.00 EPS was affirmed (midpoint just below consensus - the original selloff trigger). At ~21x affirmed EPS with a 20% growth target and the largest US nuclear fleet, the stock is now roughly fairly priced with a free option on the hyperscaler PPA wave arriving once PJM clarity lands.
catalysts: PJM data-center interconnection rules expected late 2026 - the gating item for hyperscaler PPA announcements
New data-center PPA signings (the delayed re-rating catalyst; Seeking Alpha's 'buy the pullback before deals arrive' case)
Crane Clean Energy Center restart milestones (Microsoft PPA; interconnection-delay resolution)
FY2026 guidance delivery ($11.00-12.00 adjusted operating EPS, affirmed)
risk_factors: Regulatory gauntlet is the whole story: PJM interconnection timing, DOJ divestitures (York 2 and other stations already removed from the model), and nuclear licensing all outside management control
Crane delay to 2031 would impair the $1.6B restart investment and the flagship Microsoft relationship
Guidance midpoint below consensus started the derating - and no PPA announcements can land until late 2026 to reverse it
Utilities carry structural capex; earnings-to-FCF conversion is weaker than the EPS suggests
If AI power demand forecasts prove overbuilt, the scarcity premium on nuclear evaporates entirely

q1_2026_results.note: beat 2.53 consensus; revenue 11.1B vs 8.6B expected (Calpine acquisition)

fy2026_guidance_eps.note: affirmed; midpoint 11.50 vs 11.73 consensus - the selloff trigger

growth_target.note: management 20% growth target per Q1 slides

crane_investment.note: restart investment at risk if PJM interconnection slips to 2031
